method: Built-in OpenAI image generation in Codex; transparent_background=true
direction: Transparent product-topic illustrations; exact official icons and product names integrated separately in HTML.

assets.title: OpenShift — container orchestration
assets.scene: Show container orchestration as the dominant concept: one precise red application platform supporting three distinct grouped sets of small red/white software workload containers. An open application window with layered deployment panels connects to those three workload groups through a tidy branching cyan service-routing path. The architecture must read as a software container platform with application deployment and scale-out replicas, not cargo containers or a hardware warehouse. Give the red platform a recognizable strong silhouette and make the route and repeated workloads obvious.
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: transparent product-topic illustration for a professional Red Hat Open Tech Quest event website.
Primary request: one immediately recognizable software-technology composition, with a true transparent alpha background. This is NOT an architectural room or miniature physical workshop. Express the actual product/topic through its characteristic software workflow.
Art direction: premium technical editorial illustration, precise near-isometric shapes with restrained dimensional depth, sharp edges, matte red #ee0000 focal surfaces, charcoal and light neutral secondary surfaces, small cyan #008b9a connector accents. Sophisticated enterprise product-launch artwork, high contrast and legible at 300px wide. One clear dominant concept and no more than three related supporting components; arranged as one connected coherent visual.
Composition: landscape 3:2 canvas. Full composition visible, centered within the middle 80% of the canvas, balanced negative space around it. Everything outside the objects must be actually transparent alpha=0, including all four corners and the space between components. No surrounding rectangular panel, background wash, ground plane, floor, colored backdrop, baked checkerboard, vignette, white halo or exterior cast shadow. Solid material surfaces within the objects are fine.
Brand integration: the website will place the exact official product icon and product name alongside this artwork in real HTML. Do not draw, approximate or invent any logo, wordmark, product name or typography in the image.
Avoid: physical room walls, furniture, server-room scenery, plumbing, industrial machinery, generic equipment racks, holograms, neon glow, brains, robots, people, sci-fi props, glossy blobs, decorative confetti, disconnected floating cubes and random icons.
Output: a genuinely transparent PNG with smooth clean alpha edges; preserve every object, no clipping.

assets.title: Ansible — playbook automation
assets.scene: Show Ansible-style declarative automation as the dominant concept: one large upright playbook document with unmistakably indented YAML-like horizontal strokes and three aligned checkmarks, anchored by a crisp red angular play/run control at its edge. Three tidy branching connectors run from the one playbook to a compact server endpoint, a laptop endpoint, and a network appliance endpoint, all coordinated as a single workflow. The single source of instructions fanning out to many managed systems must be unmistakable. Document strokes are abstract lines, no actual words or invented code.

assets.title: RHEL — enterprise Linux
assets.scene: Show enterprise Linux as the dominant concept: a large charcoal terminal window with a red top bar, a clearly visible simple shell prompt made only of the characters $ and an underscore, and a few crisp horizontal command-output strokes. This terminal sits above a solid layered red operating-system foundation; one small gear and one neat running-service module connect to that foundation. The composition should instantly read as Linux administration, shell work and reliable operating-system services, not a generic server room. Keep the terminal and red foundation dominant and easy to recognize.

assets.title: AI — model inference
assets.scene: Show applied AI inference as the dominant concept: a central red model-compute processor with layered tensor-like slots and a tiny orderly network of connected nodes engraved into its top, taking a small stack of document/data cards from the left and producing a clean answer/chat card on the right. Use two clear cyan flow connections so input, model and inference output read immediately as one software workflow. No chemistry lab, sample vials, humanoid robot or glowing brain. The model processor and its input/output relationship are the visual identity.
